purpose: Confermare che lo studente sa usare l'argomento senza spiegazioni, cue espliciti o feedback durante lo svolgimento.
required_properties: at least four distinct exercise formats
at least six distinct subskills or objectives
at least two integrative items combining more than one subskill
at least one connected context, mini-text or dialogue
at least one controlled-production item such as translation, correction or question formation
distractors based on plausible learner errors rather than obviously absurd options
neutral task titles that do not reveal the grammar rule needed to answer
enough context that the answer is determined by meaning, not one isolated trigger word

difficulty_profile.rule: Challenge comes from combining decisions, producing language and reading context, not from obscure vocabulary.

prohibited_patterns: six to eight near-identical one-line multiple-choice questions
question titles such as Use, Negative, Auxiliary or Short answer when the title gives away the tested rule
a test solvable mainly from signal words such as now, usually, yesterday or tomorrow
immediate correctness feedback before the whole verification is submitted
more than two consecutive items using the same exercise type and sentence pattern
testing content outside the lesson brief simply to make the verification harder
relationship_to_school_phase: Modalità scuola prepares the learner for common school formats. Verifica argomento independently samples the whole topic and must still stand as a credible assessment on its own.
relationship_to_full_review: A voluntary full-topic review ends with this verification, but completing that voluntary review does not lower an already consolidated Recovery mastery state.
